description: This file defines a Java interface 'AdapterResolver' which declares a method to resolve and retrieve the appropriate Adapter for a given Adaptable object. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package and references external classes like Signal and Adapter.

classes.name: AdapterResolver
classes.description: A Java interface used to resolve and return the correct Adapter for a given Adaptable object.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns the Adapter suitable for converting the provided Adaptable object into a Signal.
